meanings.implement: Realize the currently approved DESIGN/INTERFACE as the first POC round. TOPIC/DESIGN stay frozen.
meanings.continue_exploring: Keep the same TOPIC/DESIGN. Open another DELTA round (measure/analyze/in-design tweak). Do not amend contract slices.
meanings.amend: Same active_hypothesis only: revise binder or contract slices and re-run affected gates. Hypothesis fork MUST NOT use amend; draft a track=poc proposal and open a sibling topic.
meanings.promote: Close the topic by promoting a verified slice to Trunk.
meanings.partial: Close a verified subset; leave the topic exploring.
meanings.reject: Close the topic as a negative result.

briefing.summary: R1 entropy analysis (A1 candidate) on current Trunk a143392. Groundtruth top-100 (9999 queries, k=1024): normalized entropy 0.9945 (saturated near max), purity 0.0634, dominant_frac 0.0237; top-100 candidates span ~94/1024 clusters. Cluster concentration does not occur in top candidates; entropy has near-zero per-query variance (std 0.0038). Verdict: A1 (cluster entropy) provides no incremental signal over distance features, consistent with R0 purity negative. A2/A3 remain deferred. Heavy PQ coarse simulation not started (decisive negative). Topic remains exploring; no promotion, no close.
briefing.verdict: A1 (cluster entropy) does NOT provide incremental signal
